deliverableLanguage.description: Language for deliverables, e.g. en or pt-BR. Empty = English (framework default).

contextFiles.description: Files under workspace/projects/<project>/context/ that skills may read, with what each contains.

agents.description: Agents enabled in this project (names from agents/ or workspace/library/agents/). Absent = every available agent.

writeAllowed.description: Whether skills may propose changes in this repository (each change still needs approval).

knowledgeSources.description: Where the project's documentation lives. Skills consult only indicated sources, never the whole base.

type.description: e.g. confluence, notion, google-drive, sharepoint, files

scope.description: Relevant spaces, projects, folders or pages

templates.description: Overrides for deliverable templates, mapping template key to a path under workspace/projects/<project>/.

externalDataSharingAllowed.description: Whether project data may be sent to external services. Defaults to false.
